text:
ethan_user: Hey @support, our AcmeProd dedicated cluster didn't scale up quickly during a 3pm traffic spike — saw a bunch of 429s and 5-10s tail latency while min_replicas was 2 and traffic spiked to 150 RPS. Putting repro and logs below.

rafael_support: Sorry — can you paste the trace_id + account id? Any billing or IAM errors? Also screenshot of the warm pool state?

ethan_user: trace=trc-7f9a, acct=acme-prod-42. No billing alerts in console. Repro steps:
1) send 150 RPS for 60s to /v1/generate
2) model: redwood-medium-v1, pinned
3) min_replicas: 2, max_replicas: 20

curl example:
```bash
hey -n 1000 -c 150 "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"
```

logs excerpt:
```log
2024-11-07T15:03:12Z probe=warm-pool check=miss reason=attach-ratecap
2024-11-07T15:03:14Z autoscaler=controller desired=12 current=2 reason=provision-throttle
2024-11-07T15:03:18Z provisioning=node-23 imagePullBackOff
2024-11-07T15:03:25Z autoscaler=controller backoff=30s
```

maya_sre: Hmm probe=attach-ratecap suggests registry/image pull or IAM throttling. Can you share cluster region and whether private registry is used? Also what's the probe interval and autoscaler_holdoff? 

ethan_user: region=us-west-2, private registry=false. probe interval=5s, probe timeout=2s, autoscaler_holdoff=60s.

ashley_ops: Confirmed no billing holds for acct. I see a short spike of image registry 429s from eu-cache hitting our global registry rate limit — likely noisy neighbor. Sending logs to #vendors.

nora_platform: @rafael_support tagging eng-platform — suspected causes: (A) attach ratecap due to registry throttling; (B) initial spinup blocked by imagePullBackOff; (C) min_replicas too low for the sudden ramp causing probe backlog. Short-term mitigations: bump min_replicas for this customer during business hours, pre-pull images into warm pool, reduce probe timeout to 1s and backoff to 10s. Long-term: add regional circuit to route pulls to local mirror.

zoe_engineer: Also consider temporary fallback route to a smaller quantized model or lower max_seq to reduce warmup time. We can set per-route fallback in rollout config. 

deploy-bot: deploy started by nora_platform — warmpool:prepull job queued (job-id=wp-3321)

rafael_support: Repro checklist for ops:
- confirm imagePullBackOff count > 0 in the time window
- check registry 429 metrics and IAM token rotate history
- check node_autoscaler backoff events
- capture k8s events for pending pods

ethan_user: attaching k8s events paste: https://paste.redwood.ai/abc123

maya_sre: Quick triage: look at NodeUtilization and PodPendingTime — I'll run a one-off to reproduce with a scaled up min_replicas=6 and see if scale latency improves. ETA 30m.

ashley_ops: Sending customer note: 'We're investigating autoscale delays and have kicked off prepulls and a platform mitigation. We'll update in 30m.' :thumbsup:

nora_platform: Action items:
- eng-platform: enable local registry mirror for us-west-2 (P1)
- platform-ops: propose scheduler change to prioritise warmpool attach for reserved accounts
- support: confirm if customer wants temporary min_replicas bump

rafael_support: Marking as SEV3 -> escalated to eng-platform. thread closed after next update.
